title: C. ECD Mapping Tool for Community-Based ECD Facilities

sections.title: 1. Information about Geographical Location/Aho urugo rukorera

items.text: The facility has access to the road./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rugeraho umuhanda.
The distance from home to the facility does not exceed 500 m. /Urugendo abana bakora kuva mu rugo iwabo kugera ku rugo mbonezamikurire ntirurenga metero 500
Children are accompanied by an adult to and from school. /Umwana agera ku rugo mbonezamikurire akanataha aherekejwe n’umuntu mukuru.
The facility is recognized by local authorities. /Aho urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera hazwi n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze.

There is a primary school close to the facility to ease transition from pre-school to primary education. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite ishuri ribanza hafi kugira ngo bizorohere abana bahiga gukomeza mu mashuri abanza.

sections.title: 2. Information about Physical Environment/Imiterere y’aho urugo rukorera

items.text: The compound and surrounding areas are free from harmful objects, rubbish and have proper disposal for trash. /Mu rugo imbere n’ahahakikije hafite umutekano, nta bintu byakwangiza abana bihari nk’ibintu bityaye cyangwa ibyatsi bihumanya.
The playground is dry, not waterlogged. /Ikibuga abana bakiniraho kirumutse nta mazi aretsemo.
All wells and pits are properly covered. /Ibyobo by’amazi byose bipfundikiye neza.
Water containers and clean drinking water are available. /Urugo rufite ibikoresho bibikwamo amazi yo kunywa.
There are facilities to harvest rainwater. /Urugo rufite ibikoresho bifata amazi y’imvura.
The facility has an electricity supply. /Urugo rufite amashanyarazi kugira ngo byoroshye ikoranabuhanga mu myigishirize.
Buildings and equipment are accessible by all children /Inyubako n’ibikoresho ntabwo biheza abana n’abakozi bafite ubumuga.

At least three classrooms are available for a complete cycle: Grade 1, Grade 2 and Grade 3./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite nibura ibyumba bitatu bijyanye n’imyaka y’abana: umwaka wa 1, umwaka wa 2, umwaka wa 3
Classrooms are clean, dust-free and have at least one rubbish bin per classroom. /Icyumba kigirwamo kirasukuye, nta vumbi ririmo kandi gifite igikoresho bashyiramo imyanda

Classrooms are child friendly: age-appropriate, visually stimulating with meaningful decorations, engaging and culturally appropriate. /Ibyumba byigirwamo bijyanye nimyaka y’abana, bitatse ku buryo bikurura abana bikabashishikariza gukora.
The play and learning rooms have cement/tiled/ sealed earthen floor and are cleaned every day. /Icyumba cyo kwigiramo no gukiniramo gishashe neza, kirimo isima cyangwa kirakurungiye.
The roof is made of tiles or iron sheets. /Igisenge gisakaje amabati cyangwa amategura.

Each classroom has two windows at least 1 m x 1 m in opposite walls to allow enough light and ventilation. /Buri cyumba cyo kwigiramo gifite amadirishya abiri ya metero kuri metero kugira ngo abana babone urumuri n’umwuka bihagije

Classrooms are accessible for use by children with special needs, and have ramps, rails and lower door handles. /Icyumba cyo kwigiramo ntigifite ingazi (esikariye) kugira ngo byorohere abana bose kwinjira no gusohoka
A caregiver’s chair, table and cupboard are available. /Mu cyumba kigirwamo harimo intebe n’ameza by’umurezi.

Indoor space allows free movement between furniture for mobility-aid users and children with visual impairment./ Mu cyumba kigirwamo hari umwanya uhagije hagati y’intebe kugira ngo byorohere abana kwinyagambura cyane abafite ubumuga.
Tables and benches/chairs are child age-appropriate./ Intebe n’ameza bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana, biraramba, kandi bisize amarangi y’amabara atandukanye

Mats are available in each classroom for activities such as reading, storytelling, and play, corner play, theme display, group work etc. Umusambi/umukeka uteguye mu ishuri kugira ngo abana bakorereho ibikorwa bitandukanye byo gusoma, kubara inkuru, n’indi mikino.
Open shelves, cupboards, boxes or other containers are used to store learning materials./ Etajeri, akabati, udusanduku cyangwa ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa mu kubika ibikinisho n’izindi mfashanyigisho
The classroom has enough bag/clothes hooks for children. /Buri cyumba kigirwamo gifite aho kumanika imipira, n’ibikapu by’abana.

A chalkboard or similar large writing surface (movable or fixed) is placed slightly above the floor (20 cm) for children to access it easily. /Ikibaho gitereye kuri santimetero 20 uvuye ku butaka kugira ngo abana bose bashobore kugikoresha.
A sleeping space is reserved in one corner of the classroom for special cases. /Mu cyumba kigirwamo hateganyijwe aho umwana ugize ikibazo yaryama bibaye ngombwa n’ibiryamirwa by’ingenzi.
The kitchen roof is made of durable materials (tiles or iron sheets). /Igikoni gisakaje amabati cyangwa amategura
The cooking place is at least 2 m x 2 m and uses an economical stove./ Icyumba cyo gutekeramo gifite nibura metero 2 kuri metero 2 kandi hakoreshwa amashyiga ya rondereza.
The cooking area is clean and tidy./ Aho batekera hahora hasukuye kandi hatunganyije.
The kitchen is supplied with clean water. /Igikoni gifite amazi meza. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bogerezamo ibyombo
The kitchen has a place for washing utensils. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bogerezamo ibyombo.
Utensils are kept safely in a clean, covered container. / Ibikoresho byo mu gikoni bibikwa mu kintu gipfundikirwa.
Plastic items are not used for hot food or drinks. / Ibikoresho bya purasitike ntabwo byemewe ku biribwa cyangwa ibinyobwa bishyushye cyane.
Kitchen has a table or shelf as a drying area for dishes after washing. / Igikoni gifite ahantu ho kumukiriza amasahani, ibiyiko n’amakanya nyuma yo kubyoza.
Kitchen is separate from classrooms and toilets./ Igikoni kitaruye amashuri n’imisarani.
Kitchen is ventilated and well-lit. / Igikoni gifite umwuka uhagije, urumuri ruhagije kandi gifite umuyoboro usohora umwotsi hanze.
The floor slopes slightly to ease cleaning. / Hasi mu gikoni hacuritse buhoro kugira ngo byorohe kuhakorera isuku bakoropa amazi.
Waste disposal facilities are in place. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bigenewe gushyiramo imyanda

There are separate toilets/latrines for boys and girls, clearly labelled with child-friendly signs. /Imisarani y’abakobwa itandukanyijwe n’iy’abahungu hifashishijwe amagambo n’amashusho ku buryo byorohera abana kuyitandukanya.
There are separate male and female lockable toilets for adults. /Abantu bakuru bafite umusarani wabo kandi urakingwa, abagabo bafite uwabo n’abagore uwabo

Latches (locks) inside and outside are fixed at the height of 60-80 cm from bottom for children’s easy access. /Icyo bakingisha inyuma n’imbere gitereye kuri cm 60-80 uvuye hasi kugira ngo abana bashobore kuhagera biboroheye

There is a pictorial and printed hand-wash sign on each toilet/latrine door to remind children and caregivers to wash hands with water and soap after using the toilet./ Hari ishusho/ifoto cyangwa inyandiko yibutsa abana n’abandi bantu gukaraba intoki n’amazi n’isabune nyuma yo gukoresha ubwiherero

The handwashing facility is near the toilet, of age-appropriate design and installed at the height of 50 cm measured from the floor./ Igikarabiro cyangwa kandagira ukarabe biri ku kigero cy’abana kandi biri kuri cm 50 uvuye hasi

sections.title: 6. Information about Outdoor Play area and Equipment/Aho abana bakinira hanze n’ibikoresho by’imikino.

items.text: There is an outdoor play area./ Hanze aho abana bakinira harasukuye kandi nta byakwangiza abana bihari

There is safe outdoor play equipment and materials for motor skills and holistic development: rubber swing, seesaw, slides, swings, merry-go-round, sandbox, set of tyres etc./ Hanze hari ibikoresho by’imikino bifasha abana mu miyego itandukanye n’imikurire mu ngeri zose.

Outdoor play areas have enough space between play equipment to enable mobility aid users to move freely and safely. /Hanze aho abana bakinira abarezi bagenzura ko ibikoresho by’imikino bitabuza abana kwinyagambura cyane abafite ubumuga.
Child-friendly fixed equipment includes low slides and logs to walk on, ladders, tunnels etc. /Ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana nk’imyicungo n’ibyo bagenderaho, n’ibindi.
Movable play materials include ropes, balls, tyres, hoops etc./ Hari ibikinisho byimukanwa bigizwe n’imigozi, imipira, amapine, ibiziga, n’ibindi.
There is a sandpit for sand play activities. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite icyobo kirimo umucanga wo gukiniramo n’ibikoresho bitandukanye byo gukinisha mu mucanga

There is a water play area with recycled containers, hoses/water pipes and other world discovery tools. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite aho abana bakinira n’amazi bifashishije ibikoresho bitandukanye bituma bavumbura ibintu byinshi ku mazi.

Play materials are smooth and undamaged, with no sharp edges or protruding surfaces. /Ibikinisho bifite ubuso bunyerera, butabyimbye, imigongo idatyaye, ku buryo bitangiza abana mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose.
Jumping, climbing and sliding areas should be covered with soft ground, sand or grass. /Aho abana basimbukira, aho bazamukira ku ngazi, aho bicungira hari itaka ryoroshye, umucanga cyangwa ibyatsi
There is play equipment for children with disabilities. /Hari ibikinisho by’abana bafite ubumuga
Locally made play and learning materials and toys are available. /Uretse ibikinisho bigurwa byakorewe mu nganda, hari n’ibikinisho byakozwe mu bikoresho biboneka aho urugo mbonezamikurire ruherereye.

sections.title: 7. Information about Health Practices and Procedures/Ubuzima

items.text: Children aged 3–5 years are screened for developmental delay/ disability by community health workers, or early detection by parents, health professionals./ Abana kuva ku myaka 3- 5 barasuzumwe hagamijwe kureba abafite cyangwa bafite ibyago byo kugira ibibazo by’idindira mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

Children’s registration forms are available with information on identification, health status, contact information of parents/ guardians, and any parental concerns./ Amafishi y’umwana harimo ifishi igaragaza umwirondoro w’umwana, ubuzima bwe, ifishi y’ikingira, terefone z’ababyeyi ndetse n’ibindi bibazo ababyeyi bazi ku mwana birahari.
Immunization cards are used during registration of children. /Ifishi y’ikingira yifashishwa mu gihe cyo kwandika umwana
The facility has a health worker’s contact for health-related issues. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite inomero za terefone z’umujyanama w’ubuzima zitabazwa bibaye ngombwa.
The facility has information about children with medical insurance. /Urugo rufite amakuru y’abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza.

Guidelines with pictures on how to manage communicable disease outbreaks or promote good practices such as handwashing are posted. /Amabwiriza ajyanye n’uko abantu birinda indwara zandura, ibyorezo, gukaraba intoki aramanitse kandi aherekejwe n’amashusho abisobanura.
Children are regularly monitored for healthy growth by the local CHW and/or health professionals. /Ubuzima bw’abana bukurikiranwa n’umujyanama w’ubuzima.

The facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote safety at household and facility levels for children’s wellbeing. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorana cyane n’Inshuti z’Umuryango n’anabayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze.

The Ministry of Health, through CHWs, regularly administers deworming pills to children. /Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ibinyujije ku bajyanama b’ubuzima igenera abana imiti y’inzoka ku buryo buhoraho mu ngo mbonezamikurire.

sections.title: 8. Information about Food and Nutrition Practices/Imirire

items.text: There is a kitchen to prepare children’s meals. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite igikoni gitegurirwamo amafunguro y’abana igihe bari ku kigo.
During mealtimes, children are always supervised by an adult. /Mu gihe cyo gufata amafunguro, abana bakurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru.
Food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety. /Abatetsi n’abandi bafite aho bahurira n’ibiribwa bahorana isuku, bakaraba intoki bakanambara ingofero

Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and cover their hair. /Abatetsi cyangwa abandi bantu bafite aho bahurira n’ibyo kurya bahawe amahugurwa ku bijyanye no gutegura amafunguro afite isuku.

sections.title: 9. Information about child protection and safety Practices /Umutekano no kurinda umwana.

items.text: All staff receive regular training on relevant health and safety issues./ Abakozi bose bahabwa amahugurwa ahoraho ku bijyanye n’ubuzima n’umutekano w’abana bibera mu kigo mbonezamikurire.

Outdoor play equipment is maintained regularly to ensure it is in good condition and safe for children. /Ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze nk’imyicungo n’aho bakinira mu mucanga bihora bisuzumwa kandi bikitabwaho kugira ngo hagenzurwe niba nta mpanuka byateza abana.
There are firefighting facilities on the premises. /Hari ibikoresho byakwifashishwa mu gihe habaye inkongi y’umuriro

Where there is electricity, covered sockets are used to protect children from electric shock. /Aho urugo mbonezamikurire rufite umuriro w’amashanyarazi, aho bacomekera ibikoresho hakoreshwa ibikoresho byabugenwe bidatuma abana binjizamo ibintu uko biboneye.
First aid kit and any medicines are kept out of children’s reach./ Hari agasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze n’imiti ibamo bibikwa kure aho abana bategera.

All ECD service providers are trained how to use the contents of the first aid box and how to deal with accidents. /Abatanga serivisi z’imbonezamikurire bose bahuguwe ku bijyanye no gukoresha ibiri mu gasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze n’uburyo bakwitwara mu gihe abana bagize impanuka.
Illustrated guidelines on how to prevent accidents and deal with emergencies are posted. /Amabwiriza yo kwirinda impanuka n’uko wakwitwara mu gihe k’ibiza aramanitse kandi aherekejwe n’ibishushanyo.
Emergency telephone numbers are available. /Nimero za terefone zihamagarwa mu gihe habaye impanuka ikomeye cyangwa ikindi cyago zimanitse ahantu abakozi bose bazibona byoroshye.
Children are supervised by an adult when playing outside. /Abana bafite umuntu ubakurikirana igihe bakina hanze./ Abana bafite umuntu ubakurikirana igihe bakina hanze.

Measures preventing corporal punishment and abuse are established and communicated to school staff and parents./ Ingamba zibuza ibihano bibabaza umubiri n’ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana zashyizweho kandi zimenyeshwa abakozi bose b’urugo mbonezamikurire ndetse n’ababyeyi.

Hazardous materials and sharp objects are kept out of children’s reach (e.g. knives, petrol, gas, cleaning solutions, construction leftovers etc.)/ Ibikoresho byateza impanuka bibitswe kure aho abana batagera.

All toys for younger children are non-toxic and oversized so that children cannot swallow or choke on them, or put them in their ears. /Ibikinisho byose bigenewe abana bato ntibisize irangi ryakwangiza abana baramutse babishyize mu kanwa
An enclosed compost pit is located at the farthest corner of the compound. /Icyobo kijugunywamo imyanda kirikure y’aho abana bakinira kandi kiratwikiriye kubera umutekano w’abana.

sections.title: 10. Information about WASH Practices/Amazi, Isuku n’Isukura

items.text: Containers with safe drinking water and a cup for each child are available and cleaned regularly. /Hari ibikoresho bibika amazi yo kunywa kandi bigirirwa isuku ku buryo buhoraho
Clean water is always available for caregivers and children to wash their hands./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite amazi meza yo gukaraba mu ntoki no gutegura amafunguro.
There is running water in the premises or at a public water point no further than 500 m away./ Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hari isoko y’amazi cyangwa amazi aboneka nibura muri metero 500 uvuye ku rugo
Clean, functioning toilets are available all times. /Hari gahunda ihoraho y’isuku kugira ngo ubwiherero buhorane isuku.
Children have clean clothes and shoes. /Abana bafite imyambaro ifite isuku kandi bambara inkweto.

A water container with clean water and soap is available in the classroom, toilets, kitchen and any other place necessary. /Ibikoresho bibika amazi n’isabune birahari kugira ngo byifashishwe mu isuku yo mu mashuri, mu misarani, mu gikoni n’ahandi hantu mu kigo.
Mobile handwashing stations (kandagira ukarabe) are available near the toilets./ Ibikarabiro cyangwa kandagira ukarabe biri hafi y’ubwiherero.

Adequate, enclosed waste disposal facilities (rubbish pit, waste bin or any other mode of garbage) are available and regularly emptied. /Hari ibikoresho byabugenwe byo gushyiramo imyanda, bividurwa ku gihe kandi bigapfundikirwa ku bw’umutekano w’abana.
Bushes, potholes and pools of water around the facility are cleared to deter snakes and mosquitoes. /Ibihuru n’ibizenga by’amazi byakuweho kugira ngo bitaba indiri y’inzoka n’imibu.
There are educational posters on the importance of handwashing and balanced diet. /Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hari icyapa kigisha abana ibijyanye no gukaraba intoki ndetse n’indyo yuzuye.
All WASH facilities are accessible by children with disabilities. /Ibikoresho by’amazi, isuku n’isukura ntibiheza abana bafite ubumuga.

sections.title: 11. Information about Organisation of Teaching and Learning Activities/Play activities/Kuyobora ibikorwa by’imyigire n’imyigishirize.

items.text: Activities are planned around the six learning areas of the pre-primary curriculum. /Abana bakoraibikorwa biteza imbere ubushobozi mu byigwa bitandatu by’integanyanyigisho.
Children are engaged in activities that develop fine motor and pre-writing skills./ Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bibafasha kuzamura ubushobozi bwo gukoresha intoki n’ibibategura kwandika.
Daily schedule is at least 4 hours. /Gahunda y’ibikorwa by’umunsi imara nibura amasaha 4.
Facilities follow REB proposed schedule (the same as in school-based ECDs). /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu rukurikiza ingengabihe yatanzwe na REB na NCDA

Children with sensory impairment have access to materials that maximize their capabilities e.g. large-print, high contrast etc. /Abana bafite ubumuga mu byumviro bitandukanye bafite ibikoresho bibafasha kubona amakuru ashoboka ku mfashanyigisho ku byigwa bitandukanye.

The daily schedule balances and alternates activities: quiet-noisy; indoor-outdoor, active-passive; large group-small group etc. /Gahunda y’umunsi igenda isimburanya ibikorwa: ibikorwa bituje-ibisaba kuvuga, ibyo mu nzu n’ibyo hanze,…
The classroom encourages children to play with a range of materials. /Uburyo ishuri riteguye bukurura abana kandi bushishikariza gukinisha ibikinisho bitandukanye

Children’s original drawings, writing and other work are displayed on the walls at their eye level. /Ibishushanyo by’abana, inyandiko zabo n’ibindi bikorwa byabo bimanikwa ku rukuta rw’ishuri aho biborohera kubirebaho.
An adult/caregiver supervises the sharing of outdoor play equipment. /Hari umuntu mukuru cyangwa umurezi ufasha abana gusangira ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze.

The facility applies UDL principles (proof in lesson plans or daily and weekly plans) /Ibikorwa bya buri munsi, uburyo bw’imyigishirize, aho abana bigira, ibikoresho bakoresha, ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho byimakaza amahame y’uburezi budaheza.

sections.title: 12. Information about Teaching and Learning Resources/Imfashanyigisho z’imyigire n’imyigishirize

items.text: Every ECD provider delivers services based on the REB and NCDA approved curriculum for children aged 3–6 years./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite integanyanyigisho zemejwe n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze (REB) n’Ikigo k’Igihugu Gishinzwe Imikurire no Kurengera Umwana (NCDA).

There are appropriate learning materials for all learning areas: Discovery of the world, Numeracy, Languages, Creative Art and Craft, Physical development and Health, Social and emotional learning./ Hariibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho kuri buri kigwa k’integanyanyigisho.
Children’s writing materials: books, writing materials like pens, pencils, chalks, crayons, paper, and notebooks are available./ Abana bafite ibikoresho byo kwandikisha n’ibyo kwandikaho.

Materials used in pre-primary are locally available, culturally acceptable, age appropriate, inclusive, durable, safe and clean, attractive etc./ Imfashanyigisho zikoreshwa mu ngo mbonezamikurire akenshi zikozwe mu bikoresho biboneka aho urugo ruherereye, zijyanye n’umuco w’abana, ziri ku kigero cy’abana.

Play materials are appropriate to the local context and imitate games children play at home. /Imfashanyigisho n’ibikinisho zijyanye n’ubuzima abana babayemo kandi zisanisha n’imikino abana bakina iyo bari mu rugo.
Textbooks and other approved documents are available. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite ibitabo, ibitabo by’inyongera byo gusoma n’izindi nyandiko zemejwe.

sections.title: 13. Information about Establishment, Registration and Accreditation/ Gutangiza no kwandikisha urugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: The facility is registered. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu ruranditswe.
The facility is accredited /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite uruhushya rwo gukora

sections.title: 14. Information about Management of a Community-Based ECD facility/Imicungire y’urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote.

items.text: Children enroll in Grade 1 when they are 3 years old or will turn 3 in the first trimester./ Abana bemerewe kujya mu rugo mbonezamikurire mu mwaka wa mbere ni abafite imyaka 3 cyangwa abazayuzuza mu gihembwe cya mbere
Parents/guardians were involved in setting up the facility./ Ababyeyi bagize uruhare mu ishingwa ry’urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu.

Children are registered using immunization cards or birth certificates./ Amafishi y’ikingira cyangwa ibyemezo by’amavuko ni byo bishingirwaho bakira abana aho gushingira ku bizamini bihabwa abana kugira ngo bemererwe

Management is under the parents general assembly, the ECD executive committee, control committee and advisory committee./ Ubuyobozi bw’urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu bugizwe n’inama rusange y’ababyeyi, komite nyobozi, komite ngenzuzi, na komite ngishwanama.
All parents/guardians meet in a general assembly at least once a term./ Ababyeyi bose bahurira mu nama rusange nibura rimwe mu gihembwe.

In collaboration with ECD frontliners, the service provider ensures that children at risk of developmental delay or disability are enrolled./ Ku bufatanye n’abakorerabushake bashinzwe imbonezamikurire y’abana bato mu nzego z’ibanze (ECD frontliners), abana bafite idindira mu mikurire n’abafite ubumuga barandikwa.

sections.title: 15. Information about Recruitment and qualification of caregivers/Ishyirwa mu kazi ku barezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu.

items.text: Caregivers have one of the following qualifications:/ Impamyabushobozi ishingirwaho ni imwe muri izi zikurikira:

indicators.label: • Secondary certificate (S6) with training in ECD by REB, NCDA, district or development partners. /A2 ECE/ECLPE yatanzwe n’Ishuri Nderabarezi (TTC)

• Secondary certificate (S6) with training in ECD by REB, NCDA, district or development partners./ Nibura amashuri 6 yisumbuye (A2) no kuba yarahawe amahugurwa ku bijyanye n’imbonezamikurire y’abana bato yateguwe na REB, NCDA, Akarere, Abafatanyabikorwa.

• Secondary certificate (S6) in general education or associate nursing graduates plus at least 2 years’ experience in pre-primary teaching and childcare./Amashuri yisumbuye (S6) mu bumenyi rusange cyangwa ubuforomo n’uburambe bw’imyaka nibura ibiri yigisha mu ngo mbonezamikurire.

items.text: Caregivers are continuously trained, mentored as needed through CPD. /Abarezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire bahora bahugurwa, bagirwa inama igihe cyose bikenewe binyuze muri gahunda y’amahugurwa ahoraho (CPDs).
A parent committee selects the caregivers for the facility. /Guhitamo abarezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire bikorwa na komite y’ababyeyi
